event.text: Call 911 now, even though you feel back to normal. Sudden slurred speech and facial droop that resolve can be a warning of a stroke, and the highest risk period is the next couple of days — this needs emergency assessment and brain/vessel imaging today, not a message-based review. Do not drive yourself. If symptoms return while you wait, tell the dispatcher immediately.
